standardDemands.label: Deploy Anti-Smog Water Sprinklers
standardDemands.text: Immediate deployment of motorized anti-smog guns and misting sprinklers along school access roads and intersections between 06:30 AM and 09:30 AM on high-AQI school days.

standardDemands.label: Halt Uncovered Construction & Dust Near Campus
standardDemands.text: Strict inspection and enforcement of covered construction protocols or mandatory temporary cessation of dust-generating civil works within a 1-kilometer radius during school operating hours.

standardDemands.label: School Gate Traffic Bottleneck Mitigation
standardDemands.text: Stationing municipal/traffic marshals at school perimeter gates to strictly prohibit heavy vehicle transit and eliminate engine idling during student arrival (07:00–08:30 AM) and dispersal (01:30–02:30 PM).

standardDemands.label: Sanction Indoor Air Filtration / HEPA Grants
standardDemands.text: Administrative approval and municipal grant assistance for installing certified True-HEPA air cleaning units and air curtains across primary school classrooms and assembly corridors.

standardDemands.label: Official Air Quality Protocols for Recess & PE
standardDemands.text: Issue an enforceable circular requiring non-penalized indoor recess, cancellation of outdoor physical endurance drills, and relocation of morning assemblies whenever local PM2.5 crosses 120 µg/m³.
